_doc: Where production is, so that something can check whether it serves what `main` says.
AGENTS.md rule 11 says GitHub `main` is the source of truth and EdgeOne Pages is the
production host. Nothing verified the second half until 2026-08-07, and one reason is that
the address was written down nowhere in this repository -- you cannot verify a deployment
you cannot name. Every check here asked whether the repository was right; none asked whether
the thing readers open is the repository.
`productionUrl` is the origin only, no path: the checker appends `/models` itself.
Null means the check reports itself as unrun, every day, in the collection-gaps issue --
loudly rather than silently, because a deployment check that quietly does nothing is
indistinguishable from a deployment that is fine.
Read by scripts/check-deployment.mjs, which can also be pointed somewhere with --url, and
which reads SITE_URL from the environment first if that is set.
